october_2026_issuer_filings.facts: Item 7.01: AXP and American Express Travel Related Services consented to Federal Reserve orders; American Express National Bank (AENB) consented to an OCC order and agreed to a $350M civil money penalty. Company says a portion was reserved in prior periods, the penalty does not affect previously supplied FY2026 guidance, consent orders impose no asset cap, and remediation costs are not anticipated to affect FY2027 guidance. This is a quantified legal/regulatory item with explicit issuer guidance treatment.

Item 7.01 supplies preliminary Sep 2026 U.S. consumer/small-business delinquency and principal-only write-off statistics. Sep consumer principal-only net write-off rate 1.5% (Aug 1.7%); small-business 2.1% (Aug 2.2%); combined average-card balance shown as $160.9B. These are preliminary portfolio indicators, not reported companywide Q3 GAAP EPS or a replacement EPS figure.
